pages.text: Despite the lack of sunlight, several species of trees grow in the Beneath, most of which can only be found here!$(br2)Trees grow in the Beneath the same way they do in the overworld, but they do require a light level of 12, which isn't provided by the Beneath's natural light. To solve this problem, you can utilize $(l:agriculture/aqueducts)Lava Aqueducts$() or any other available light source.

pages.title: Buk

pages.text: $(bold)Mangrove$()$(br)Found only in the $(thing)Muggy Bog$() biome.$(br)$(thing)Growth Days$(): 7$(br2)Can also be found $(l:the_world/earth_tree_index#mangrove)in the overworld$().
